text:
- The Owner intends to develop, own and operate a natural-gas-fired combined cycle power plant of 600 MW net output on the Site on the northern Marmara coast (the "Project").
- The Owner invited tenders for the engineering, procurement and construction of the Project on a lump-sum turnkey basis and accepted the Contractor's tender as clarified during negotiations.
- The Contractor has examined the Site, the Owner's Requirements and all information made available and is satisfied as to the sufficiency of the Contract Price.
